first-land: Smooth landing. This is "{{name}}" — one question compressed into three districts.
Eight opinions live here now, in three camps: the stop-loss camp, the steady camp, and the rights camp.
The monument to the north only marks the most upvoted voice in the current material; the fog belt marks where the material cannot reach. Neither is a conclusion.
Talk to the station keeper first, or walk straight into any district. Press E to talk to residents.
enter-mist: You noticed the fog — this is the Long-term Fog Belt.
Among the discussions we collected, there is almost no follow-up evidence three to five years after a bare resignation.
That does not mean there is no answer here — only that the current material cannot illuminate it. The fog is not an opinion; it is the unknown.
A traveler lives in the mist; his claim holds only under strict conditions. Go listen, or remember this place and come back when more material arrives.
before-leave: The city right now: 8 opinions, 3 camps, and one fog belt nobody has lit up yet.
Remember, the terrain only reflects the material collected so far — new voices may reshape it.
Tap the rocket when you are ready; close my chatter if you want to wander more.

first-land: Districts are drawn automatically from opinion camps; every resident carries a real or inferred opinion.
Press E to talk to them and hear their reasons.
before-leave: Heading back? This city only reflects the material collected so far.
Tap the rocket when you are ready; close my chatter if you want to wander more.
